name: Anbernic RG35XX H / RG35XX Pro / RG40XX H
identify: helperFunctions.sh: cpuinfo CPU part "*0xd03*" (H700) -> reads BASEOS_TARGET from /etc/baseos-release; case "rg35xxh"/"rg35xxpro"/"rg40xxh", and the default (`*`) arm -> PLATFORM=AnbernicXX640480

pad.note: A/B/X/Y, L1/R1, digital L2/R2, SELECT/START, MENU (plus its KEY_GOTO tap pulse), D-pad hat, stick axes, FF rumble and, on the RG35XX Pro and RG35XX H, the volume keys (measured 2026-11-12), all on one event1 node (also js0)

vol.note: vendor's own typo for the node name, kept verbatim. It declares 114/115, but on the RG35XX Pro and RG35XX H nothing fired on it (2026-11-12); other models of the line send the volume keys here (NextUI port, controller-matrix event2 entry)

VOL_UP.from: measured: button-reader-AnbernicXX640480-1.txt (RG35XX Pro run 1); button-reader-AnbernicXX640480-2.txt (RG35XX H run 2)
VOL_UP.note: on the RG35XX Pro and RG35XX H the key arrives on ANBERNIC-keys and nothing on dierct-keys-polled; the RG40XX H is unmeasured. The NextUI port saw the RG34XX SP and RG40XX V use dierct-keys-polled under other firmware; the RG34XX SP on BaseOS 1.4.0 uses ANBERNIC-keys too (2026-11-12)

VOL_DOWN.from: measured: button-reader-AnbernicXX640480-1.txt (RG35XX Pro run 1); button-reader-AnbernicXX640480-2.txt (RG35XX H run 2)
VOL_DOWN.note: on the RG35XX Pro and RG35XX H the key arrives on ANBERNIC-keys and nothing on dierct-keys-polled; the RG40XX H is unmeasured. The NextUI port saw the RG34XX SP and RG40XX V use dierct-keys-polled under other firmware; the RG34XX SP on BaseOS 1.4.0 uses ANBERNIC-keys too (2026-11-12)

absent.LID: no lid on any model in this bucket
absent.HOME: cfg B_HOME="DOESNT_EXIST"; MENU is spruce's home key on this line (matrix)
absent.FN_SWITCH: no latching Fn switch on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)
absent.FN_LEFT: no Fn keys distinct from L3/R3 on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)
absent.FN_RIGHT: no Fn keys distinct from L3/R3 on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)

notes: SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME is computed at runtime; all three named members have their own arm in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg: rg35xxh -> "Anbernic RG35XX H", rg35xxpro -> "Anbernic RG35XX Pro", rg40xxh -> "Anbernic RG40XX H".

VOL_KEY_WATCHER_PATH/POWER_KEY_WATCHER_PATH/CONTROLLER_KEY_WATCHER_PATH are exported in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg (event0/event2/event1) but nothing in the h700 tree reads them -- dead variables, not evidence for any control's source (grep of spruce/scripts at spruce_ref 0dccf5276b).

This platform is also helperFunctions.sh's catch-all default arm (`*) export PLATFORM="AnbernicXX640480"`): any BASEOS_TARGET not named in its case statement lands here too, with SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME="Anbernic $(BASEOS_TARGET upper-cased)". This manifest only covers the three named, known members; a future unlisted BASEOS_TARGET falling into this bucket needs its own hardware check before trusting this file for it.

controller-matrix.json (generated 2026-09-06) and h700-baseos-deep-dive.md predate the current spruce_ref's helperFunctions.sh split: they still fold rg35xxplus, rg35xxsp and rg40xxv into this same AnbernicXX640480 bucket. At spruce_ref 0dccf5276b those three now have their own PLATFORMs (AnbernicXX640480NoStick, AnbernicXX640480OneStick) -- bucket membership in this file was re-derived from helperFunctions.sh directly, not copied from that older table; only the per-model layout/lid facts from it were reused.
models are spruce's own SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME values (AnbernicXXCommon.cfg); Button Reader matches the unit's name against them
